framework: AWS Security Best Practices + HackTricks Cloud AWS
description: KMS key policy, grants, and encryption posture checks

items.title: KMS key policy allows wildcard or broad cross-account principals
items.description: Overly permissive key policies can enable cross-account decrypt/encrypt or management of CMKs.
items.remediation: Restrict key policies to explicit principals and add conditions (aws:SourceAccount, aws:PrincipalArn) where applicable.

pci_dss.reason: Cryptographic keys must be protected from unauthorized access and misuse.

items.title: Unexpected KMS grants allow decrypt or data key generation
items.description: KMS grants can provide stealthy access to decrypt or generate data keys without changing key policies.
items.remediation: Review and revoke unexpected grants; enforce least privilege and monitor CreateGrant/ListGrants usage.

pci_dss.reason: Use audit logs to detect unauthorized changes and access attempts.

items.title: Principals can modify KMS key policy or create grants
items.description: Permissions like kms:PutKeyPolicy or kms:CreateGrant can be abused for persistence or privesc.
items.remediation: Restrict KMS administrative permissions and enforce separation of duties for key administration vs key usage.

pci_dss.reason: Least privilege principle for access to sensitive systems and cryptographic controls.

items.title: Customer-managed KMS keys do not have rotation enabled
items.description: Long-lived keys increase blast radius if compromised and reduce cryptographic hygiene.
items.remediation: Enable automatic key rotation for customer-managed CMKs where supported.

pci_dss.reason: Cryptographic key management processes should include rotation as appropriate.

items.title: KMS policies allow destructive key availability actions
items.description: Actions like DisableKey, ScheduleKeyDeletion, DeleteImportedKeyMaterial, DeleteAlias, or UpdateAlias can be abused for ransomware-like denial of service.
items.remediation: Restrict destructive KMS actions to tightly controlled break-glass roles and monitor CloudTrail for policy/key state changes.

pci_dss.reason: Security incident response procedures should detect and contain key-management abuse impacting availability.

items.title: Imported key material can be deleted (Origin=EXTERNAL)
items.description: For CMKs with imported key material, DeleteImportedKeyMaterial can render encrypted data inaccessible if abused.
items.remediation: Use dedicated admin roles for imported-key lifecycle actions and alert on DeleteImportedKeyMaterial attempts.

pci_dss.reason: Cryptographic keys must remain available and protected from unauthorized lifecycle operations.

items.title: KMS grants enable persistence via CreateGrant delegation
items.description: CreateGrant permissions in grants can allow durable delegated access and persistence over key usage.
items.remediation: Remove unnecessary CreateGrant operations from grants, enforce grant constraints, and continuously review grant inventory.

pci_dss.reason: Least privilege must be enforced for cryptographic control delegation.

notes: KMS is region-scoped. Findings must be backed by policy/grant evidence references.
